card.name: Linking words before the next drug or treatment
card.fires_on: Commas, 'with', 'and', 'as' or a space that sit right before the next item in a list of treatments or drugs. It also fires on the gap between a number and a repeated number in a dose range.

modes.label: Link before a listed treatment
modes.description: A comma, 'with', 'and' or 'such as' just before the next drug or treatment in a list.
modes.example: treatment of soil with steam<<,>> microwaves or UV rays

modes.label: Premedication with
modes.description: 'with' or the next word after premedicate or premedication, before the named drug class.
modes.example: Patients must receive premedication<< with>> antiemetics and appropriate hydration

modes.label: Dose range gap
modes.description: The space before the second number in a dose range.
modes.example: Maintenance, 2 g to<< >>4 g, divided into 3 to
